★ How to Bet on Betfair Exchange & Get Better Odds

The Betfair Exchange lets you take the Betfair Starting Price (BSP) — the true market price at race-off. This is ALWAYS better than the bookies by 10–50% in our experience. Here’s exactly how to do it.

1
Join Betfair
Go to betfair.com/exchange/plus and create a free account if you haven’t already.
2
Use the Exchange — NOT the Sportsbook
Once logged in, make sure you click Exchange (not Sportsbook) at the top of the page. The Exchange is where you get BSP and real market prices. The Sportsbook is just a regular bookmaker.
📝 Look for the two tabs at the top: ExchangeSportsbook — always choose Exchange.
3
Find the Race & Click the Blue Cell
Navigate to today’s race. You’ll see a grid of runners with odds columns. Find your horse and click on the blue cell next to its odds — this opens a bet slip on the right-hand side.
🔵 The blue cells are the Back prices (betting the horse to win). The pink cells are the Lay prices — ignore those.
4
Set Odds to 1000 & Stake to £1
In the bet slip that opens, you’ll see two boxes: Odds and Stake.
⚠️ Be careful here! Set Odds = 1000 and Stake = £1. Do not mix them up — you do NOT want £1000 stake at odds of 1!
Your bet will show: Liability: £1.00 — you only risk £1 regardless of the odds shown.
5
Click “Place Bets”
Hit the yellow Place Bets button. Your bet will be submitted. Because 1000/1 won’t be matched by the market, you’ll see it appear under Unmatched Bets — this is exactly what we want.
6
Select “Take SP” and click Update
In the Receipt / Unmatched Bets panel you’ll see three radio options for what happens at In-Play: Cancel, Keep, Take SP. Select Take SP then click the yellow Update button.
✅ Your bet is now set to take Betfair Starting Price at the off. You’re done! The bet will be matched automatically at race start.

💡 Why does this work?

By requesting odds of 1000/1 the bet will never be matched before the race — but by selecting Take SP you instruct Betfair to match it at the Betfair Starting Price (BSP) when the race goes off. BSP is calculated from real money in the market and is ALWAYS better than the bookmakers — typically 10–50% better odds. Your liability is just £1, so there’s no risk of accidentally placing a large bet.

🏁 Betting on Places (Top 2 / 3 / 4 Finishers)

The exact same BSP method applies to place bets — the only difference is which market tab you click before selecting your horse.

1
Choose the right Place market tab
At the top of the race you’ll see tabs: Win, Each Way, Top 2 Fi..., Top 3 Fi..., Top 4 Fi... etc. Click the one that matches the number of places being paid — e.g. if a race pays 3 places, click Top 3 Finishers.
🔎 As a guide: small fields (5–7 runners) usually pay 2 places — use Top 2. Handicaps with 8–15 runners pay 3 places. Big fields (16+) pay 4 places. Check the race details to be sure.
2
Click the blue cell for your horse — same as Win
Once you’re in the place market, everything else is identical: click the blue cell next to your horse’s odds, set Odds = 1000 and Stake = £1, place the bet, then select Take SP → Update.
✅ The place BSP will be matched at race-off. Place odds are lower than win odds but you win as long as your horse finishes in the top 2, 3 or 4 — our data shows place bets return more P&L overall than win-only betting.
3
Each Way = Win + Place in one bet
Alternatively, use the Each Way tab to combine both into a single bet — half your stake on the win, half on the place. Apply the same odds 1000 / stake £1 / Take SP process. Your liability will be £2 (1 for win market + 1 for place market).
💵 Our back-test shows E/W at £2 stake returns the best total P&L of all three methods. See the Back Place History tab for the running numbers.
